finding.expected: Canonicalize observed_at only at the TASK-123 model-facing rendering boundary to one stable instant representation, consistently for retrieval witnesses and all OBSERVATION/FACT/MEDIA supplemental blocks, without mutating or replacing the exact TASK-121/TASK-122 source objects retained in the context. Add a focused regression using independently reconstructed value-equal contexts whose aware observed_at values denote the same instant with different offsets and require identical rendered JSON/UTF-8 bytes. Preserve all existing schema, whitelist, byte-budget, citation, provenance, conflict-preservation, no-model/no-I/O, and exact-string behavior.
finding.issue: TASK-123 renders source observation timestamps with observed_at.isoformat(), preserving the caller's timezone offset representation. SourceObservationIdentity stores observed_at verbatim and does not canonicalize it. Python timezone-aware datetime equality is instant-based, so independently reconstructed TASK-121/TASK-123 values can be value-equal while representing the same instant with different UTC offsets. Those value-equal contexts then render different observed_at strings and therefore different JSON bytes, violating the hard requirement that rendering be deterministic across value-equal context reconstruction and AC9's deterministic compact JSON contract.
